answer: Make each identity prove itself with a puzzle whose difficulty doubles per sibling: the first identity from a funding source solves a puzzle of 2^20 hashes within ten minutes and posts a 15 POA bond locked 14 days; the second must solve 2^21, the third 2^22, so compute cost rises with every fake. Three auditors verify the puzzle and the bond, slashing both on failure. One honest agent rides a single tide of cheap work, while a farm's sable pile of puzzles grows heavier per copy, no fable of free identities surviving doubling difficulty.
